_doc.purpose: Every judgement call made about Cape Town taxi-route place names. Edited by hand; consumed by scripts/pipeline/places.py. Editing this file and re-running is the supported way to change or undo a merge.
_doc.aliases: Keyed on the POST-tidy() display string - spaces, commas and parentheses preserved, apostrophes already removed, uppercase. Value 'to' is the replacement, also a post-tidy() string.
_doc.preferred: Keyed on canonical_key() - A-Z and 0-9 only, no spaces or punctuation. Chooses the display form for a group whose members are all equally valid spellings. NOT interchangeable with 'aliases' keys.
_doc.rules: Regex transforms applied after the alias table, in sorted id order. Set enabled=false to switch one off.
_doc.keep_distinct: Hard block: no two members of a group may end up as the same canonical place. Blocks alias entries, regex rules and canonical_key grouping alike. This is the per-merge undo.
_doc.after_editing: python scripts/clean_routes.py validate-config && python scripts/clean_routes.py run
